summary: Equity Residential filed an 8-K on June 7, 2026, disclosing an amended offer letter for Benjamin Schall, current CEO of AvalonBay and incoming CEO of the combined company after the pending merger-of-equals with AvalonBay. The amendment confirms his FY2027 compensation. The filing updates prior disclosure of the Merger Agreement announced May 20, 2026, which is an all-stock combination with no stated price per share, premium, or break fee. No board recommendation or advisor named in this filing. The Merger remains subject to conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder vote timing.
